title: Pink Hammer Girl Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with pink hair and a large purple hammer. From left to right: standing with hammer on shoulder, swinging the hammer with pink energy trails, striking impact with a bright yellow starburst explosion, and a ready stance holding the hammer.
prompt: A punk girl with bright pink hair in pigtails, wearing a pink and black cropped jacket, short skirt, and black boots with green laces. She wields a massive purple and black warhammer. Four sequential action poses shown side by side: idle stance with hammer over shoulder, powerful swing creating pink motion trails and energy, direct hit impact with bright yellow starburst explosion, and final ready stance. Bold comic book line art, vibrant colors, dynamic action effects on a solid gray background.
